title: Summer Shadow — Recruiting the Next Generation
description1: During summer break, Variable Velocity opened its doors to younger students through our Summer Shadow program. We invited kids from the community into our workshop to experience firsthand what a robotics team looks like — from CAD design to hands-on building.
description2: Team members led interactive sessions where new students learned the basics of coding, 3D modeling, and mechanical assembly. The goal was simple: spark curiosity and show kids that robotics is for everyone, not just the ones who already know how to build.
bullets: Recruited new students through community outreach and word of mouth
Taught coding fundamentals, CAD basics, and robot building
Hands-on sessions in our team workshop with real FTC components
Several participants joined our team for the upcoming season
